Name: DE-Requests
Statement:
-- +ASSIGNMENTS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Request)
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Request)
with
cut as
(
    select  a.DocumentOid as Id
    from    Assignment a
    where   a.DocumentTypeName = 'Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Request' and 
            a.[User] = @CurrentUserId
    group by a.DocumentOid
)
select	doc.Oid as DocumentOid,
        doc.Oid as RequestId,
        doc.Name as Request,
        doc.Number as RequestNumber,
        doc.BeginDateUtc,
        doc.EndDateUtc,
        doc.CreatedOnUtc,
        doc.ModifiedOnUtc,
        datediff(day, getdate(), doc.EndDateUtc) as Days,
        doc.TagsJson,
        doc.IsActivated,
        usrCb.Name as CreatedBy, 
        usrCb.Id as CreatedById, 
        usrCb.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage, 
        usrCb.TagsJson as CreatedByTags,
        c.Name as Company,
        c.Id as CompanyId,
        c.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        clg.Name as ClientGroup,
        cclu.Name as Client, 
        cclu.Id as ClientId, 
        cclu.HasImage as ClientHasImage, 
        ccl.Name as ClientClassification,
        jt.Name as Type,
        jt.StyleJson as TypeStyle,
        ccp.Name as Product, 
        brd.Name as Brand,
        con.Name as Contract, 
        con.Id as ContractId, 
        isnull(loc.Name, ws.Name) as Stage,
        isnull(ws.Color,wst.Color) as StageColor, 
        usrMb.Name as ModifiedBy, 
        usrMb.Id as ModifiedById, 
        usrMb.HasImage as ModifiedByHasImage, 
        doc.IsDraft, 
        uc.Id as CreatedByCompanyId,
        uc.Name as CreatedByCompany,
        uc.HasImage as CreatedByCompanyHasImage,
        wst.Name as StageType,
        iif(bor.Oid is not null, 1, 0) as AlreadyRead,
        iif(cut.Id is null, 0, 1) as CurrentUserInTeam,
        bor.Oid as BaseObjectReadId,
        uf.Oid as FavoriteId,
        iif(uf.Oid is not null, 1, 0) as IsFavorite,
        wkf.Name as Workflow,
        doc.Priority,
        doc.Version,
        dep.Name as Department,
        dep.Id as DepartmentId,
        div.Name as Division,
        div.Id as DivisionId
from	Request doc
            left join UserFavorite uf on uf.DocumentId = doc.Oid and uf.[User] = @CurrentUserId
            left join UserLookup usrMb on doc.ModifiedBy = usrMb.Id
            left join CompanyLookup c on doc.Company = c.Id
            left join Clientlookup cclu on doc.Client = cclu.Id
            left join ClientGroup clg on clg.Oid = cclu.ClientGroup
            left join ClientClassification ccl on cclu.Classification = ccl.Oid
            left join JobType jt on doc.JobType = jt.Oid
            left join DepartmentLookup dep on dep.Id = jt.Department
            left join DivisionLookup div on div.Id = dep.Division
            left join CommercialClientProduct ccp on doc.Product = ccp.Oid
            left join Brand brd on brd.Oid = doc.Brand
            left join UserLookup usrCb on doc.CreatedBy = usrCb.Id
            left join CompanyLookup uc on usrCb.Company = uc.Id
            left join ContractLookup con on doc.Contract = con.Id
            join WorkflowState ws on doc.WorkflowState = ws.Oid
            join Configuration cfg on 1 = 1
            left join UserLookup usr on usr.Id = @CurrentUserId
            left join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = usr.Company
            left join LocalizationLanguage lol on lol.Name = isnull(com.DefaultLanguage, cfg.DefaultSystemLanguage)
            left join Localization loc on loc.DocumentOid = ws.Oid and lol.Oid = loc.LocalizationLanguage
            left join Currency curr on curr.Oid = c.Currency
            join DocumentType wkf on wkf.Oid = doc.DocumentType
            left join cut on cut.Id = doc.Oid
            left join BaseObjectRead bor on bor.ObjectId = doc.Oid and bor.ObjectType = 'Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Request' and bor.[User] = @CurrentUserId
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = ws.WorkflowStateType
